widget_mechanic: Compose: ≥N-bedroom plus-chip AND single-family-only property-type filter.

source_inspiration.instruction: I'm looking to buy a house in Omaha, NE with 4 or more bedrooms, a large lot, and near top-rated schools. Can you find a listing that meets these criteria?
source_inspiration.first_failure_summary: [1.4] Wrong values or constraint violation: The agent concluded the listing’s lot size (7,405.2 sq ft) “satisfies the large-lot requirement,” even though this is not convincingly a large lot and is inconsistent with the agent’s earlier stated minimum lot filter of 1/4 acre (10,890 sq ft).
